title: China-to-Greece Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: EMC — IEC 62920 and IEC 61000 Evidence for Greece PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: Greek PV inverter EMC expectations should be prepared on an IEC basis because ELOT is the national standards body and project specifications for grid-connected PV commonly reference IEC-family inverter evidence. Because Greece is an EU member state, EMC conformity must also be demonstrated under the EU EMC Directive 2014/30/EU as part of CE marking. The practical EMC package should include IEC 62920 for PV power conversion equipment and applicable IEC 61000-series evidence for emissions, immunity, harmonics, surge, voltage dips, and power quality. For IPTO/HEDNO grid-connected projects, harmonic and conducted-emission evidence should be tied to the actual inverter model, rating, and configuration. Because Greece uses a 230/400 V, 50 Hz grid, EMC and harmonic results obtained only under China 220/380 V conditions should be reviewed for applicability before submission.
target_standards: Directive 2014/30/EU (EMC Directive) — mandatory for CE marking in Greece/EU
IEC 62920 — Photovoltaic power generating systems — EMC requirements and test methods for power conversion equipment
IEC 61000 series — Electromagnetic compatibility test, immunity, harmonic, surge, voltage-dip, and power-quality standards as applicable to the inverter configuration
ELOT standards adoption and project specification requirements where applicable
IPTO/HEDNO grid-connection review requirements for power quality and harmonic performance
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter EMC evidence commonly relies on GB/T 37408-2021 and related domestic EMC test reports from CNAS-accredited laboratories. These reports can be useful engineering background but are not automatically equivalent to IEC 62920, the IEC 61000-series evidence, or the EU EMC Directive conformity requested by a Greek project owner, ELOT conformity route, RAAEY review, or IPTO/HEDNO grid-connection process. China test conditions are normally aligned with the China 220/380 V, 50 Hz baseline, while Greece uses 230/400 V at the same frequency.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CNAS-accredited domestic EMC test reports under China standard scopes
rows.gap: Gap: China-only EMC certificates under GB/T 37408 do not automatically satisfy Greek IEC-based project expectations or the EU EMC Directive. Exporters should obtain IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000-series reports for the specific model or family, demonstrate EMC Directive conformity for CE marking, confirm whether harmonics and conducted-emission results remain valid at 230/400 V, and provide surge, earthing, shielding, and enclosure documentation suitable for Greek installation environments. Where IPTO/HEDNO or the project owner specifies harmonic limits or power-quality measurements, test reports should be mapped clause-by-clause to that requirement.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — EMC Directive 2014/30/EU conformity is required for CE marking in Greece; IEC 62920 and IEC 61000-series evidence is effectively required where ELOT, RAAEY, IPTO/HEDNO, or project-owner documentation calls for IEC EMC and power-quality evidence
mandatory_status.cn: GB/T 37408 EMC evidence is a China domestic voluntary or certification-programme baseline and is not a Greece IEC/EU EMC Directive evidence substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat Greek PV inverter EMC as an IEC evidence package plus EU EMC Directive conformity for CE marking, not a China GB/T certificate transfer. Prepare IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000-series reports for the exact inverter model, review harmonic and EMC applicability at Greece's 230/400 V 50 Hz grid voltage, and confirm any ELOT, RAAEY, IPTO/HEDNO, or project-owner EMC requirements before shipment.

rows.requirement: Greece IPTO/HEDNO Grid-Connection Review — IEC 62116, IEC 61727, and 230/400 V 50 Hz Settings
rows.target_requirement: Grid-connected solar PV inverters in Greece should be treated as project-level grid-connection equipment subject to technical review by the transmission operator IPTO/ADMIE and the distribution operator HEDNO/DEDDIE, under the energy-sector oversight of RAAEY (Regulatory Authority for Waste, Energy & Water). As an EU member state, Greece also applies EN 50549-1/-2 and the EU RfG Regulation (EU) 2016/631. The practical IEC evidence package normally includes IEC 62116 anti-islanding and IEC 61727 utility-interface compliance, with firmware protection thresholds, reconnection delay, voltage windows, and frequency windows validated for Greece's 230/400 V, 50 Hz low-voltage grid. Greece uses the same 50 Hz frequency as China, but the nominal voltage differs: Greece is 230 V single-phase and 400 V three-phase, while China is 220/380 V under GB/T 156. Greece has a strong solar-deployment programme and significant non-interconnected island grids, so commissioning files should also document thermal derating and weak-grid ride-through assumptions for the installed site.
target_standards: IEC 62116 — Utility-interconnected photovoltaic inverters — Test procedure of islanding prevention measures
IEC 61727 — Photovoltaic systems — Characteristics of the utility interface

RAAEY electricity-sector approval or oversight requirements where applicable
Greece low-voltage grid context — 230 V single-phase / 400 V three-phase, 50 Hz
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter grid-connection evidence commonly includes GB/T 19964-2024 for PV power station connection, NB/T 32004 for grid-connected inverter technical specifications, GB/T 37408 for PV grid-connected inverter requirements, and domestic anti-islanding test results. These documents are built around China grid conditions and domestic acceptance procedures. China's low-voltage baseline is 220/380 V at 50 Hz, not Greece's 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Chinese grid certificates and factory firmware settings do not automatically transfer to IPTO/HEDNO acceptance or RAAEY project review in Greece.
china_standards: GB/T 19964-2024 — 光伏发电站接入电力系统技术规定 (Technical Requirements for Connecting Photovoltaic Power Station to Power System)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
rows.gap: Gap: China GB/T and NB/T grid-connection evidence is not a substitute for Greek IPTO/HEDNO project acceptance or EN 50549 / EU RfG compliance. Exporters should prepare IEC 62116 anti-islanding evidence, IEC 61727 utility-interface evidence, EN 50549 type-test reports, a Greece-specific settings file, and commissioning records for 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Do not describe Greek voltage as matching China: only the 50 Hz frequency matches, while nominal voltage differs from China's 220/380 V. For island-grid or non-interconnected sites, include humidity, thermal derating, earthing, surge protection, and weak-grid ride-through assumptions in the project file.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory in practice for grid-connected projects through IPTO/HEDNO technical review and RAAEY oversight; EN 50549 and EU RfG (EU) 2016/631 are binding for in-scope generating modules
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese grid-connection evidence satisfies China domestic grid acceptance only and is not an IPTO/HEDNO Greece approval substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Chinese GB/T grid-connection documents do not automatically satisfy Greek IPTO/HEDNO grid-connection review. Prepare IEC 62116, IEC 61727, and EN 50549 evidence, re-parameterise inverter firmware for Greece's 230/400 V at 50 Hz grid, and document thermal derating and weak-grid behaviour for island or non-interconnected installations. Verify current IPTO, HEDNO, and RAAEY project requirements directly before shipment or commissioning.

rows.requirement: IEC 62109-1 / IEC 62109-2 Safety Evidence and Environmental Derating for Greece PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: For Greek solar PV projects, inverter safety documentation should be prepared around IEC 62109-1 and IEC 62109-2 type-test evidence for the exact inverter model or family, and demonstrated as part of CE marking under the EU Low Voltage Directive 2014/35/EU. ELOT is the national standards body, RAAEY oversees the energy sector, and IPTO/HEDNO control the practical grid-connection interface, so project submissions should include accredited IEC safety reports, installation manuals, ratings, nameplate data, protection-device coordination, earthing instructions, and environmental limits. Greece has a hot, high-irradiance Mediterranean climate with significant island exposure, so safety files should also address enclosure ingress protection, terminal temperature rise, ventilation, and derating for high ambient temperatures, humidity, and coastal/island marine exposure.

rows.china_equivalent: China safety documentation for PV grid-connected inverters commonly uses GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, domestic CQC or CGC voluntary certification, and CNAS-accredited laboratory reports. These documents are useful for supplier qualification but are not automatically accepted as IEC 62109-1/-2 evidence or EU LVD CE-marking evidence for Greek projects. Chinese safety reports may also be based on China-rated configurations, labels, manuals, surge protection, and 220/380 V assumptions, while Greek project files must reflect 230/400 V, 50 Hz installation conditions and Mediterranean/island environmental exposure.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CQC / CGC voluntary certification programmes for China domestic PV inverter safety and performance
rows.gap: Gap: A China-only GB/T 37408 or NB/T 32004 safety file does not automatically satisfy Greek IEC safety expectations or EU LVD CE-marking requirements. Exporters should provide IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test reports for the supplied model or model family, demonstrate LVD conformity for CE marking, confirm that labels and manuals match the Greek configuration, document protection coordination and earthing, and add environmental evidence for high ambient temperature, salt-mist corrosion, ingress protection, humidity, ventilation, and thermal derating. Any changes to enclosure, terminals, firmware settings, surge protection, or nameplate ratings for Greece can require updated safety documentation.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — CE marking under LVD 2014/35/EU is required for Greece/EU market access; IEC 62109 safety evidence is effectively required where ELOT, RAAEY, IPTO/HEDNO, EPC, lender, insurer, or project-owner documentation calls for it
mandatory_status.cn: China GB/T, NB/T, CQC, or CGC safety evidence applies to China domestic or voluntary certification contexts and is not automatically transferable to Greece

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not rely on China GB/T or NB/T inverter safety files alone for Greek PV projects. Prepare IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test evidence for the exact model, demonstrate LVD conformity for CE marking, align labels and manuals to Greece's 230/400 V 50 Hz configuration, and document high-ambient-temperature, humidity, ingress-protection, corrosion, and thermal-derating controls. Confirm current ELOT, RAAEY, IPTO/HEDNO, and project-owner safety requirements before shipment.
